summary: Outputs depth, color, player masks or XYZ point-cloud images from a Nuitrack sensor.
key_concepts: Multiple TOPs can expose different images from one sensor.
Depth values represent distance in meters.
common_gotchas: Requires Windows, supported hardware and a separate Nuitrack license.
Player masks use 0.1 for player one, 0.2 for player two.
Point-cloud pixels encode XYZ, not ordinary display color.
platform_notes: Windows only; hardware tracking remains unverified without a licensed sensor.
